description: Piano d'azione rumore da traffico 2013 is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Provincia Autonoma di Trento. Relativamente all'inquinamento acustico prodotto dalle infrastrutture di trasporto, in particolare quelle di tipo stradale, la normativa nazionale ha definito fasce di pertinenza acustica, limiti di immissione e interventi per il rispetto dei limiti. Coverage: Provincia Autonoma di Trento. The portal files it under the publisher Provincia Autonoma di Trento. Its tags are ambiente, mobilita, rumore, servizio-gestione-strade, strade. It offers 2 resource(s) in KMZ, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
